subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

 'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B'

 'A − B' means 'A is the brother of B'

 'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B'

 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'

 Based on the above, how is M related to Q if 'M × N − O + P ÷ Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png]

Given Expression: M × N – O + P ÷ Q

M × N: M is the wife of N.

N – O: N is the brother of O.

O + P: O is the sister of P.

P ÷ Q: P is the father of Q.

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b18156d25d471b7822ec8d82b3d0bfe71645b64f7902d85c9efb4df577dfe14.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/458bb47210f8bbf6b1faf26bbe3adfeab3070f51b217a143bdcc249d9082bb46.png] 

Therefore, M is **Father's Brother's Wife** of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
